opportunities.title: Intern 2027 - Silicon Team
opportunities.description:
Role: Engineering Intern –IP / SoC /Logic design/ Validation/ Physical Design Software / Characterisation & Bring-Up
Company: Graphcore
Level: Internship

About the job

Start your Internship career helping build the silicon behind tomorrow’s AI systems. Our Internship Programme is designed to give you the technical experience, support and responsibility to build a successful career in AI computing.

The Semiconductor Engineering Intern will work alongside experienced engineers on the design, development, verification, validation, or software enablement of advanced semiconductor products and technologies. The internship provides hands-on exposure to real-world engineering challenges across areas such as processor/SoC design, digital design, verification, embedded software, performance analysis, and silicon validation.

Interns will contribute to active engineering projects while developing an understanding of semiconductor product development methodologies, tools, and processes.

You will work close to expert engineers who explain the detail, challenge your thinking and help you grow. You will build practical skills in SoC Design, development, verification, Validation, Bring-up & Characterisation, software, hardware or Physical Design checks.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate.
